verdict: Approved for the assigned scope. Page 240 (Metadata/Legal/Contributor credits/Sources) has no clipping or overlap. The CC0 license link, the contributor credits (Markup editor and Transcriptionist, Codex), and the full source citation are all present and legible. The citation keeps the Internet Archive identifier and URL, the imaging/library credit, the 'scan is the source' statement, the independent-reader credit, and the note that no translations were supplied for passages absent from the English edition. The manifest has no pending source-pointing questions. This approval does not cover the batch's liturgical pages (the source 294–311 content, the priestly-blessing introduction end point, or the label for the missing later source), because no images of those pages were assigned. They need their own image review if they have not already had one.
